title: dipcatcher receipt.v2
description: Unified sealed-receipt envelope for research evidence (ULTRAPLAN P7.2 + P7.4). Lane-specific content lives in `payload`; the envelope binds dataset/code/params digests, the numeric environment fingerprint, and the honesty flags. The executable contract is `quant_fund.research.receipt_v2.ReceiptV2`; keep this file in sync with it.

data_label.description: Honesty label for the evidence source, e.g. SYNTHETIC. Never REAL for synthetic lanes.

git_revision.description: Checked-out revision or an explicit unknown marker.

dataset_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON identity of the evaluated dataset (e.g. per-shard content hashes).

params_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON run parameters (models, grid, sizes, seed).

code_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON map of writer source file hashes.

code_files.description: Writer source files keyed by basename; the audit trail behind code_sha256.

packages.description: Distribution versions; must cover numpy, polars, scipy.

threadpools.description: Loaded BLAS threadpools (threadpoolctl); empty when unavailable.

fingerprint_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of every other environment field — the P7.4 determinism fingerprint.

live_pnl_claim.description: Honesty flag: receipts never claim live P&L.

verdict.description: Top-line evidence verdict. blocked = intentionally incomplete evidence (e.g. frozen-slate failure), not a pass.

payload.description: Lane-specific receipt body (e.g. a fleet_eval.v1 payload verbatim). Must not contain forbidden headline metric keys (sharpe/sortino/calmar/pnl/nav).

receipt_sha256.description: Seal: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of every other top-level field. Required on sealed files; absent only pre-seal.
